name: NUSC 5200
title: Macronutrient Metabolism
description: The digestion, absorption/transport and metabolism of carbohydrates, protein/amino acids and lipids; their functions, metabolic pathways and interrelationships; mechanisms regulating their metabolism; methodologies for studying metabolism and assessing nutrient requirements in man and animals.
requirement_description: MCB 2000 or equivalent; open only to Nutrition Sciences students, instructor consent required.
